name: Meta Glasses
description: Pair Meta Ray-Ban (Gen 2) smart glasses with your Crow BYOAI. The Crow Android app uses Meta's official Wearables Device Access Toolkit to give the glasses a voice turn powered by your configured STT + AI + TTS profiles.
author: Crow
notes: Requires Crow Android app 1.4.0+ with the Meta Wearables DAT integration compiled in. A device answers only when an assistant is bound to it in Bot Builder; the turn is the gateway's shared voice turn on that assistant's quick voice model. Speech uses a voice profile that returns raw PCM (a local Kokoro or Piper profile when the default cannot).
